component.name: ViGAPhone
component.summary: ViGAPhone is a MIDI physical modelling synthesizer, audio‑analysis, and instrument‑tuning tool.

description.p: ViGAPhone is a realistic physical modelling synthesis program for Linux or Windows computers, optionally used with a MIDI keyboard. It is designed for performing musicians, professional tuners, and occasional hobbyists.
ViGAPhone est un synthétiseur MIDI d'instruments de musique réaliste et un outil pour les accordeurs réparateurs de pianos et autres instruments de musique.
